description: Pirate scout stalking with a fleet response. A scout is sent to the ship's system and finds it. A pirate gang in the system then starts a hunt from a report on the ship; the hunt trigger is retried until the coordinator accepts a leader. The hunt calls support gangs, commits, warps in, locks and kills the ship. Off-grid travel x5 so the gangs arrive within minutes.

expect.note: the scout heads for the ship's system
the scout's sensors find the ship
the hunt starts from a report on the ship
a support gang heads for the system
support and tackle are close enough to commit
the hunt's ships warp in close to the ship
a support gang lands on the grid
every hunter the server put on grid reached the client
